press.quote: A movement each of concertos by Paisiello, Beethoven and Chopin with the splendid orchestra of young players directed by Daniele Camiz.
Daniele Camiz superb trainer/conductor of his youthful ICNT Orchestra giving to each performance superb musicianly support.
“The Roman conductor Daniele Camiz fulfills his dream on the web and reaches the final of the only online competition in the world.”
press.author: Article by Cristina Panzironi

press.quote: “The conductor is the leader of a group of people, a catalyst of human energy, a facilitator of almost magical synergies.”
press.author: Interview with Daniele Camiz
